title: SORT.
note: 7,140 technology icons on a 16 px grid and one heavy word, shuffled along the grid and sorted back into place, in black and white on paper.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] laid a 16 px grid, 70 by 102, and put one of 56 open-source [[Lucide]] technology icons at every intersection, a row of each so the page starts sorted, with SORT in [[Google Fonts]] Archivo Expanded Black across the middle and the icons knocked out white inside it. On [[Canvas]], rows then columns slide along the grid and wrap, the letters lift into their own rows and jumble, then everything sorts itself back, with a paper grain made in code laid under and over the ink.
